paras: Mina likes to [[wake|wake]] before the alarm. She opens the window in her [[bedroom|bedroom]] and listens to the quiet street.
She chooses her [[clothes|clothes]] and spends one [[minute|minute]] checking the weather. Then she drinks a glass of [[juice|juice]].
Before leaving, Mina stops to [[remember|remember]] three things: her keys, her bag, and a kind word for the first person she meets.
zh: 米娜喜欢在闹钟响之前醒来。她打开卧室的窗户，听着安静的街道。
她选好衣服，用一分钟查看天气，然后喝一杯果汁。
出门前，米娜提醒自己记住三件事：钥匙、书包，以及送给遇到的第一个人的一句友善话。

q.s: Mina wakes after the alarm rings.
She checks the weather before leaving.
q.why: The second paragraph says she checks the weather.

q.s: Mina travels to work by train.
q.why: The passage does not say how she travels.
